requiredFindings.title: F absent is the P0 shape only
requiredFindings.failureScenario: pre_acceptance is true when heads is null or history is null, and admit_current_trust returns TRUST.NO_ADMITTED_TIME_CONTEXT before any read. Item 1's P0 shape is heads and history both null and every role ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED, which check_capsule_projection already requires, together with no accepted role. Item 10 uses F absent for nothing else. A retained capsule missing only history, or a pre-acceptance capsule with an accepted role, takes F absent and never reaches that projection. Required: F absent only for that P0 shape. The early return before any read may stay for that exact shape. Any other null head, null history, or accepted role on a pre-acceptance capsule is the incomplete row.

requiredFindings.title: The 40 MiB closure total excludes the chain
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The closure check compares retained bytes, after the chain has been charged on the same counter, with 40 MiB plus 16 MiB. ChainBudget already refuses a chain over 16 links or 16 MiB, so a closure between 40 and 56 MiB with a small chain is admitted. budget_row maps Error::Cap to the budget row. retain returns Cap for empty bytes or a file over the owners' 4 MiB cap, and item 10 puts oversize on the incomplete row. Item 11 requires a pin of the real cost of a view at the 40 MiB closure with 32 events and a 16-link, 16 MiB chain, at most TRUST_VIEW_COST. The test pins the six-role store at 23 objects, 44 edges, and 35371 bytes, and the bound test covers a 33-event descriptor, ChainError::Limit, and an 8-object ledger. Required: refuse when the closure's retained bytes, excluding the chain's own ChainBudget accounting, exceed 40 MiB. Cap takes the incomplete row. ObjectLimit, ByteLimit, EdgeLimit, and Closed stay the budget row. Pin that full-size charged cost at at most TRUST_VIEW_COST. The six-role pin may remain as the ordinary-store measurement.

requiredFindings.title: Nested owner causes match their typed variants
requiredFindings.failureScenario: nested_input classifies ordinary_roots::Error::Shared and ScopeError::Inventory by scanning Debug text for the last Input( and prefix-matching budget and missing names. A cause the text misses becomes PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE. trust_ordinary_quorums::Error, trust_ordinary_metadata::Error, and retained_metadata_index::Error expose those causes as typed variants. A budget or missing cause published as PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE is request-rejected, where the budget row is operational-failed. Required: match the typed Input and nested causes. ObjectLimit, ByteLimit, EdgeLimit, and Closed are the budget row. Cap, Capture, Missing, Digest, and Reference are the incomplete row. A failed document or quorum stays PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE.

requiredFindings.title: Revoked closure members match subjectKind
requiredFindings.failureScenario: admit_bound compares an optional core_closure string to revocation subjects, ignores subjectKind, and skips the check when the option is absent. a_revoked_running_core_closure_refuses supplies closure2:cccc and admits, because the fixture list revokes nothing. The catalog envelope is reverified with filter_envelope_revoked over an empty set, and prepare_authenticated_times receives an empty revoked-key set, both before the current list's keyIds exist. The loaded list's closed kinds are keyId, namespace, release, and catalogSnapshot, and observe_revocation already matches those to closure subjects. Required: after verify_revocation, an entry whose subjectKind and subject name the admitted closure's release, signing key, namespace, or catalog snapshot refuses as CONTINUE-CORE-NOT-TRUSTED, subject that component. Reverify the other envelopes this unit checks with those current keyIds excluded. The set of keys revoked before this list stays empty. Item 2's read set has no embedded 463 revocation document; InitialCore already refuses a release entry that names the closure.

requiredFindings.title: Recovery goes through standing
requiredFindings.failureScenario: authenticate returns Continuation("recovery") when any of the six roles is State::Recovery, before standing(). The subject is the word recovery. continuation takes only core, index, and component, so a Recovery bundle, profile, or repair is outside that join. Item 1 rejects a stricter join. Required: Recovery goes through standing(), with subjects core:recovery, index:recovery, and component:recovery. A Recovery bundle, profile, or repair follows the role machine.

requiredFindings.title: The fixture-tests source pin names X4T-a's test file
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The v90 description of crates/security/src/trust/accepted_store_fixture_tests.rs says the source pin shows the constructor is named by no other source file. current_trust_admission_tests.rs names accepted_store_fixture, and the pin admits that file after checking its include sits under cfg(test) mod tests. The sentence is false. Carrying the inherited row by value leaves it false. Required: the description says the source pin admits that cfg(test) test file.

scope: X4T-a r1, items 1-6 and 8-11 of accepted X4T r5. Time is report-only; item 7 is X4T-b. RF-1: F absent is the P0 shape only. RF-2: the 40 MiB closure total excludes the chain, Cap is incomplete, and the full-size cost is pinned. RF-3: nested causes match typed variants. RF-4: revoked closure members match subjectKind, and current keyIds are excluded. RF-5: Recovery goes through standing(). Inventory v90 REQUIRED-FINDINGS: the fixture-tests source-pin sentence. Replay: opensip-security lib current_trust_admission and accepted_store_fixture, 21 passed. Workspace suite, clippy, fmt, check_package_edges, and verify_scratch were not replayed.
